title: Her rooms on F deck (the middle deck): R3, a sourced table of facts
written: 2026-11-20, by the R3 session (Claude Opus 5.5), under docs/research/RESEARCH_rooms_plans_licence_v1_1_2026-11-20.md, on the coordinator's word after the E-deck pilot
rules: Facts only: which room, where, how big, which door to which. No image or drawing of any plan is kept. Every row cites the reference read and the original checked, or says it was not checked. Bets are tagged as bets.
reference: ET: Encyclopedia Titanica's free deck plans, F deck (https://www.encyclopedia-titanica.org/titanic-deckplans/f-deck.html; drawn by Bruce Beveridge for Titanic The Ship Magnificent, The History Press 2008), read on the page in the built-in browser on 2026-11-20, nothing saved
original: Shipbuilder 1911: The Shipbuilder, Midsummer 1911 (the Olympic and Titanic number), plate 5, 'Middle Deck F' (with G, the orlops and the tank top), as reproduced by GG Archives (https://www.ggarchives.com/OT/Titanic/25-ImageLibrary/TheShipbuilder-10-Design-SpecialPlates.html); too small to read room by room.
how: As for E deck (data/rooms/E_deck.json, 'how'): walls by her frames, read off the frame numbers the reference prints every second frame along the centreline; the long walls measured on the page with a ruler in the page; the rest by eye, to about a frame and a foot (tag 'approx').

Frames to feet: the reference's own scale on this deck's image, set by her 36 in frames amidships (30.82 px a frame, 0.09734 ft a pixel), from the midship section between frames 1A and 1F. At that scale the plan's bulkheads C, D, E, H, J and K to O land within 0.2 m of the model's.

y: feet from the centreline, port positive, at 0.0982 ft a pixel (the breadth over the shell amidships, 943.5 px for 92.67 ft). 'shell+' and 'shell-' are her side; in metres the tool puts it at the model's half-breadth halfway between F and E decks [stand-in for the reference's shell].
Doors: the width is the reference's where it writes one; otherwise 2 ft 3 in [bet]. Watertight doors: 3 ft [bet; not written on the reference].
Dense cabins are blocks: one row for the cabins between two passages, with the cabin numbers listed (tag 'block').

The reference writes along her side: 'DECK DROPPED 18" FROM FRAME 21 TO 60' (F deck is 18 in lower there, under the Turkish bath and the swimming bath). The model's deck is not dropped [noted, not used].
Derived fields (x_m, y_m, poly_m, area_m2, zone, slab, plan_compartment) are written by: node tools/rooms_table.js --write data/rooms/F_deck.json

frames.note: Her frames as the reference draws them on F deck: [frame, feet forward of amidships]. Interpolated linearly between anchors. 'stern' is where her side meets the centreline on this deck [approx].

bulkheads.note: Watertight bulkheads where the reference marks them on F deck (W.T.B. labels and W.T.D. doors). All fifteen reach above F deck.
